indicator_name: Weighted average rates on bank loans issued in the month, by maturity: legal entities and individuals, KZT and FX, from 1997
description: Средневзвешенные ставки по кредитам, выданным банками за месяц, по срокам: юридические и физические лица, в тенге и в валюте, с 1997 г.
unit: % per annum, weighted by the volume issued in the month
methodology: NBK formId=486, 1997-01 onward (the scalar LOAN_RATE_ISSUED_LEGAL_KZT / _INDIVIDUAL_KZT are KZT.LEGAL.ALL / KZT.HH.ALL). Items <KZT|FX>.<LEGAL|HH>.<maturity>. The 1997-2002 files split long maturities at 3 years (Y1_3_OLD, Y3_OLD), from 2002 at 5 years. Dated by the month of issue (report_date shifted back a month).
